structured_generation_prompt:
Create a completely new synthetic taxonomy for a GET benchmark.

Use this structural target profile. It describes counts and distributions only; it is a target, not a requirement for exact matching:

{spec_json}

Return strict JSON:

{{
  "domain": "...",
  "classes": [
    "..."
  ],
  "subclass_axioms": [
    ["Child", "Parent"]
  ]
}}

Rules:
- invent new class identifiers appropriate to the domain
- use only generated class identifiers in subclass_axioms
- first item is the child, second item is the direct parent
- produce direct subclass relations
- no duplicate classes
- no duplicate edges
- no self loops
- no cycles
- multiple inheritance is allowed
- do not copy class names or hierarchy edges from any real ontology
- return JSON only
